run_eval_one_epoch: run evaluation of a 3D detection model for one epoch using a dataloader and config
run_eval_one_epoch_distributed: run distributed evaluation of a 3D detection model across multiple GPUs with result merging
run_eval_one_epoch_save: run evaluation of a 3D detection model and save prediction results to a pickle file
